titulo: Revisão e simulado do B1: Revisão: tempos e estruturas

aula.objetivo: Rever os tempos verbais, os modais, as estruturas e as habilidades do B1, e fazer o simulado final do nível.

blocos.explicacao: PASSO 1: tempos: present perfect contínuo («I have been studying for two hours»), past perfect («She had left before I arrived»). PASSO 2: condicionais: segundo («If I were rich, I would travel») e terceiro («If I had studied, I would have passed»). PASSO 3: passiva: simples, com modais e com «have something done» («I had my car repaired»). PASSO 4: relativas: who, which, that, whose, where; com vírgulas quando explicam. PASSO 5: discurso indireto: «She said (that) she was tired», «He asked if I knew». PASSO 6: gerúndio e infinitivo («enjoy doing», «want to do»), e preposições dependentes («good at», «interested in»). PASSO 7: dedução («must be», «can't have been»), futuro («will be doing», «will have done»), so/such, too/enough, conectores (although, despite, however, therefore).
blocos.comparacao: em português muitas dessas estruturas existem, mas com outros recursos (subjuntivo, mais-que-perfeito). Em inglês, cada uma tem forma própria.

tabela.exemplo: I have been studying for two hours.
She had left before I arrived.
If I were rich, I would travel.
If I had studied, I would have passed.

erros.errado: I am studying for two hours.
erros.certo: I have been studying for two hours.

erros.errado: If I was rich, I will travel.
erros.certo: If I were rich, I would travel.

erros.errado: If I had studied, I would passed.
erros.certo: If I had studied, I would have passed.

erros.errado: She said me she was tired.
erros.certo: She told me she was tired. / She said she was tired.

erros.errado: The man who he lives here is kind.
erros.certo: The man who lives here is kind.

blocos.enunciado: Escreva 8 frases, uma para cada estrutura acima, sobre a sua vida.
Fale 1 minuto sobre você: passado, presente e planos, com present perfect e futuro.
